title: Eight Core Sectors
definition: The Eight Core Sectors represent the foundational pillars of the Indian economy, comprising **Electricity, Steel, Refinery Products, Crude Oil, Coal, Natural Gas, Cement, and Fertilizers**, which collectively constitute **40.27%** of the Index of Industrial Production (IIP).
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding exact composition, weightage hierarchies, and release authorities, while Mains GS-3 examines their role in infrastructure bottlenecks, capital investments, and industrial growth linkages.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, relative weightages, and institutional compilation mechanisms of the Eight Core Sectors.
Evaluate spatial distribution, structural constraints, and policy reforms impacting these industries.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims sorting and weightage-based MCQs.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of macroeconomics and industrial output indices (IIP).
